'''Boize''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a [[General/Legends|General]]. Boize was known as a yes-man.

==Biography==
Boize was a [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] assigned to oversee the refitting and transportation of power generators captured from the former [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. They were refitted on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], and it was there that Boize was assassinated by a Rebel agent.
